entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a helmet a little while ago and I was just hoping I could still return it. Things are a bit tight right now, and I really need the money back.

I can certainly look into that for you. I just need to ask a few questions to understand the situation. What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is there a technical fault, or is it more of a preference issue?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, I'm sure. To be honest, the color just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. It's a shame, because I've been a loyal customer for so long. The box is still unopened, I never even touched it.
I understand. Getting the color and fit right is important, especially for an item related to safety. Can you provide me with the order number so I can check the purchase date?
Yes, of course. It's... VF-8675309. I feel so bad about this, I just... I really thought I'd use it.
Thank you for that. Please don't worry. Let me just pull this up... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 78 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I was so hoping it wouldn't be an issue.
Not at all. According to our policy for standard items, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, I can absolutely process this return for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just attach that to the package and drop it off. Once we receive the helmet, a full refund will be issued.
That's fantastic. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again!
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
